judged_text: The remove-link guard {{#unless automatic}} is evaluated inside the per-member item view (the sibling bindings {{member.username}}/{{avatar member}} show the context is the member), so 'automatic' resolves against the Discourse.User object — which has no 'automatic' property — instead of the group, and the remove link renders unconditionally. Admins viewing an automatic group (admins/staff/moderators/trust_level_N) see a working-looking remove icon on every member row; confirming the bootbox prompt sends DELETE /admin/groups/:id/members.json which the server rejects with 422, and the unhandled promise rejection surfaces no feedback, so removal appears to silently do nothing.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin/templates/group_member.hbs`, the remove link is guarded by `{{#unless automatic}} ... {{/unless}}`, but the `group-member` item view (`app/assets/javascripts/admin/views/group-member.js.es6`) defines no `automatic` property/binding. The template clearly expects a per-row `member` object (`{{avatar member}}`, `{{member.username}}`, passing `member` into the action), so `automatic` is not guaranteed to resolve to the group model/controller and will be falsy/undefined in the item view context, causing the remove icon to render even for automatic groups. Clicking it triggers `removeMember` → `Group.removeMember` which issues `DELETE /admin/groups/:id/members.json`; the server-side `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` returns 422 for automatic groups (`can_not_modify_automatic`), and there’s no error handling in the client promise chain, so the UI provides no feedback and appears to do nothing.
